text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I escort Symboli Rudolf to the infirmary after she suffers an injury during training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This is nothing, Trainer—hardly more than a bruise. It will heal in no time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If I were to falter at a scratch like this, I would be ashamed to call myself Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Why, I could resume training tomorrow if you wanted. Haha…
choice_data_list: I was hoping you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah… I had hoped a little humor would reassure you, but it seems to have had the opposite effect.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My apologies. I see now that putting up a brave front is not always the best answer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf makes to get up, only to freeze mid-motion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …It seems I was a little hasty in my assessment. I may need time to recuperate after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: So much for sparing my dignity…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then we are of one mind. No hardship is too onerous for the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm always vigilant for opportunities to put my ideals into practice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: This is one such time. I will not be undone by a minor mishap!
